title: Orbital Strike Cannon V2
description: This is the V2 of my orbital strike cannon. As my old plugin/mod got deleted/unlisted off of modrinth soo im fixing my old errors and uploading the new fixed version.
body:
### Features
Nuke/CapitalNuke/Stab/Wolf/Stasis/Wither

Nuke: your set rings rings

Capital: Nuke 20 rings

Wither: 10 rings of blue wither skulls

Stab: -63 to world height

Wolf: 100 wolfs

Stasis: teleports you to <x> <y> <z>

### Usage

/orbitalrod <payload> <player> (Only for stasis <x> <y> <z>, Only for nuke <size>)

/orbitalstrike <payload> <x> <z> (Only for nuke <size>)

/orbitalshulker <color> <payload> <amount>

**IMPORTANT Note:**
Paper: Set max-tnt-per-tick: 1000000 in spigot.yml
